src='''def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    threes=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==3]
    i0=min(i for i,j in threes); i1=max(i for i,j in threes)
    j0=min(j for i,j in threes); j1=max(j for i,j in threes)
    seeds=[(i,j) for i,j in threes if i0<i<i1 and j0<j<j1]
    for i in range(i0+1,i1):
        for j in range(j0+1,j1):
            if g[i][j]==3:
                continue
            dist=min(max(abs(i-si),abs(j-sj)) for si,sj in seeds)
            g[i][j]=4 if dist%2==1 else 2
    return g
'''
